title: Flight Controls — Flap Track Carriage — Installation of Double-Lip Roller Bearing Seals
abstract: Installation of double-lip seals and a chloride-resistant grease on the flap track carriage roller bearings, extending the carriage lubrication interval from 3 000 to 6 000 flight hours.

sections.planning_reason: Operators on northern networks reported rough flap running and, in eleven cases across five aircraft, unscheduled carriage roller replacement. Grease samples from four returned carriages showed chloride concentrations consistent with runway de-icing fluid, and two raceways showed early spalling. The single-lip seal fitted at build does not exclude the fine aerosol driven by the wheel spray pattern at rotation, which the track drainage arrangement then holds against the seal face.
sections.description: The carriage roller bearings receive a double-lip seal with a garter spring and are repacked with a grease qualified against chloride washout. The track drain filter is replaced by a coarser item that clears wet debris instead of trapping it, and the heat exchanger mounting is re-shimmed by 1.5 mm to restore the drain slope. A new seal retainer is closed with countersunk rivets.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Drive the flaps to the maintenance position and make the flap system safe. Get access to the carriages in zones 562 and 662. Do the removal steps of task AMM-M-27-50-13-000-005-A for one carriage at a time. Remove the existing seals and clean the raceway; report any spalling before continuing. Install the double-lip seals and repack the bearing with the qualified grease. Install the new seal retainer with rivets EN207383K8. Replace the drain filter D2750139843846 and re-shim the heat exchanger BEDE63136-96 mounting to restore the drain slope. Do the installation task AMM-M-27-50-13-400-005-A. Repeat for each carriage. Do a full flap travel test, check the regulator 5CE and the track valve 9KS3 for correct indication, and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to MRD-42K1 and MRD-46K1 aircraft from MSN M00001 through M00364 that are still pre MOD-162744. MSN M00157 and MSN M00160 are excluded because they carry an instrumented carriage on extended flight-test loan. Aircraft from the production cut-in onward already carry the double-lip standard.
sections.material_note: Kit K2750-1078-01 covers one aircraft, both wings, and contains the seals, the retainers, the drain filters and the qualified grease. Lead time is sixteen weeks. Operators are advised to combine the embodiment with the scheduled flap track lubrication so that the flaps are only driven once.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
